authorization: User approved revised B on PushObj, including B3 positive-only and B1 per-prediction-pair weighting; max 30 MPC replans.

arms.B1: Per 5-step predicted pair: weight 2 if visual OR proprio positive evidence, otherwise 1; normalize over the GLOBAL batch; TS unchanged
arms.B2: IDM MLP (visual/proprio encoded differences -> corresponding 5 executed actions); no action embedding input
arms.B3: Positive-only standardized visual/proprio distance margin 0.2, pairs 0-5,5-10,10-15,0-15; mean over all globally valid branch-pairs; unknowns unconstrained

calibration: 100 TRAIN minibatches of 64; 4000 independent source windows, 6400 deterministic draws (one full permutation plus part of a second); identical order in B2/B3; microbatch16; no updates; match auxiliary visual-encoder gradient norm to 10% of JEPA

idm_head.optimizer: same AdamW group settings and lr5e-4 as action/proprio; separate parameter group

limitations: Training changes tested first; cannot claim a learned global-static or unsuccessful-action discriminator.
Old EVAL50 is a development set, not a fresh confirmatory test.
B1 positive coverage remains high; report its measured weighting contrast.
Original A failure remains archived; the user explicitly approved relaxing that requirement for positive-only B.
